BAZZI
PODIATRY

A calm, clinically-confident identity for a foot & ankle practice — built around a mark where the letter B and a footprint become the same shape.

01The Brief

Podiatry reads as cold and clinical. Bazzi wanted the opposite — a practice that feels like relief, not a procedure.

The category is a sea of blue crosses, generic foot icons and stock-photo smiles. To stand out in a waiting-room world, Bazzi needed an identity that could carry trust and warmth at the same time — steady enough for a medical setting, human enough to make someone in pain feel looked after.

We anchored everything to a single idea: comfort you can recognise before you read a word. One mark, a disciplined petrol-and-mint system, and a voice that speaks in outcomes — Step Into Comfort, Relief Starts Here.

A

Clinical, not cold

Medical credibility without the sterile, intimidating tone the category defaults to.

B

One ownable mark

A logo that works at a 22px favicon and a three-storey billboard alike.

C

Outcome-led voice

Every headline sells the feeling of being pain-free, never the procedure.

02The Mark

A B that hides a footprint.

Dual reading

The two counters of the B are shaped as the arch and heel of a foot — the initial and the specialty in one glyph.

Negative space

The footprint is carved, never drawn — so the mark stays clean at any size and reverses cleanly on petrol.

Organic geometry

Soft, anatomical curves keep the medical tone approachable rather than surgical.

The wordmark locks up in Poppins ExtraBold — even weight, generous tracking — so the symbol always leads and the name supports. It runs in mint-on-petrol as the hero lockup, and flips to petrol-on-mint for stationery and light applications.
